product_one_liner.value: Marquee unifies club and external football data and applies AI analytics to help professional clubs with recruitment, squad planning, match preparation and related football decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The About page says Marquee turns football data into decision-ready insights and specifies that professional clubs use it for recruitment, squad planning and analytics; the product page extends this to match preparation.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation/footer lists Product, About, FAQ and News, plus a demo link, but no pricing link; no public pricing page is evidenced.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Marquee’s first-party announcements identify Reading FC as a long-term partner and Club Atlético Lanús as its official intelligence-layer customer. | named_customers.0: The first-party announcement identifies Reading FC as a long-term partner and names it as the club receiving Marquee’s intelligence-layer product. | named_customers.1: The first-party announcement says Marquee is the official intelligence layer of Club Atlético Lanús.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 19 employees, which falls in the 11-20 band; its broader company-size label is 11-50, so the precise band relies on the displayed employee count and is somewhat uncertain.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Marquee’s LinkedIn company profile explicitly lists headquarters as New York, NY. | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters as New York, NY, and the company address is in New York, NY, US; this identifies the headquarters country as the United States.

founded_year.notes: Marquee’s LinkedIn company profile states “Founded 2025,” directly supporting the year.

eng_blog.notes: The company’s news index is mainly product, partnership, press and event announcements. It includes a technical “Build or buy?” article, but does not show at least two engineering/technical posts by engineers; the index presents a company news/marketing stream rather than an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: The site navigation exposes an FAQ but no documentation or help center, and the linked FAQ is a single FAQ page rather than a public documentation portal with several product articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open-jobs page lists a Senior AI Scientist position dated November 3, 2026, and the linked posting identifies the role as AI/ML; this is an AI role in the relevant period.

model_provider.value: Marquee says it uses its proprietary AI/ML models and a purpose-built football LLM; it does not name an external model provider.
model_provider.notes: Marquee describes its LLM as purpose-built for football and says it uses proprietary AI/ML models. The cited product and homepage language does not identify an outside model vendor, so the answer reports the disclosed proprietary models without inventing a provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Marquee’s FAQ says it is SOC 2 compliant, and its first-party announcement says it completed a SOC 2 Type II audit. No other listed certification is named in these cited security claims. | compliance_certs.0: The FAQ explicitly says Marquee is SOC 2 compliant.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The funding report describes the July 2026 $4 million round as a seed round and distinguishes it from the earlier pre-seed. | funding_date: The funding report dates the $4 million seed round to July 30, 2026, so the requested YYYY-MM value is 2026-07. | funding_amount_usd: The dated funding report identifies a $4 million seed round and explains that it followed a $2.5 million pre-seed, distinguishing the latest round amount from total funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The reported $4 million seed round closed July 30, 2026, inside the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current company job board lists one open role, Senior AI Scientist, and the linked job page confirms it is AI/ML; it lists no SDR, BDR or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: Marquee announced on July 14, 2026 that SkillCorner users could newly access its tracking-derived data through Marquee, a new product data integration within the six-month window before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Tal Darchi’s LinkedIn profile gives his Marquee title as Co-Founder & Chief Data Scientist and records a start date of December 2025, within the 12 months before 2026-11-09; the profile title is a C-level position.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The product integration description and readable open-job description list the data integrations and technical tools they discuss, but name no CRM or sales/marketing system; therefore the supported signal list is empty.
